_meta.description: DeepSi turns the LiDAR and TrueDepth sensors in your iPhone or iPad into a camera that captures shape instead of light: night vision, twelve color themes, depth photos and videos. No network calls, no accounts.
a-live-depth-view.415f75: A live depth view of a person, drawn in shades of blue
all-media-captured-with.c17ca7: All media captured with DeepSi is automatically saved to a dedicated album in your Photos app. This makes it easy to access, organize, and share your unique depth-based content.
any-iphone-or-ipad.c95884: Any iPhone or iPad with depth hardware: the LiDAR scanner on iPhone Pro models from iPhone 12 Pro and iPad Pro from 2020, or the TrueDepth front camera on iPhones with Face ID. Dual rear cameras work at lower quality.
blaine-miller-all-rights.b327c2: © Blaine Miller. All rights reserved.
deepsi-on-ipad-showing.96c5f5: DeepSi on iPad, showing the shape of a person in the dark
deepsi-turns-the-depth.70601b: DeepSi turns the depth sensors in your iPhone or iPad into a camera that captures shape instead of light.
depth-photos-and-depth.8b0ee4: Depth photos and depth videos with sound, saved to a DeepSi album in your Photos library.
does-it-work-with.e0bcff: Does it work with Shortcuts and Siri?
ever-wondered-what-the.8656c0: Ever wondered what the world would look like if you saw depth instead of light?
how-does-deepsi-work.e6e2a3: How does DeepSi work in the dark?
is-deepsi-available-in.58388e: Is DeepSi available in the European Union?
lidar-uses-infrared-light.a6de83: LiDAR uses infrared light pulses to measure depth, not visible light. This means it works perfectly in complete darkness without needing to illuminate the scene. You can navigate and capture depth data even when it's pitch black.
swipe-left-or-right.aaf681: Swipe left or right to move through twelve color themes. They follow your Light or Dark Mode setting, and DeepSi remembers the one you picked.
tap-for-a-photo.1a9fbe: Tap for a photo. Hold for a video.
the-deepsi-gallery-with.eac148: The DeepSi gallery with depth photos and a video in several colors
the-depth-sensors-measure.4d484e: The depth sensors measure distance with their own infrared light, so DeepSi keeps working in a pitch-black room. Use it as a night-vision viewfinder without lighting anything up.
the-same-depth-view.cae864: The same depth view recolored in orange
what-devices-does-deepsi.ef9409: What devices does DeepSi work on?
where-are-my-photos.59433f: Where are my photos and videos saved?
yes-deepsi-is-on.67af63: Yes. DeepSi is on the App Store everywhere in the European Union, France included. It's available in every App Store territory Apple offers.
yes-make-video-from.687050: Yes. Make Video from Frames turns a set of images into a video, Get Latest Captures hands your recent DeepSi photos and videos to other actions, and you can read or change the color theme. Ask Siri for your latest DeepSi capture with no setup.
your-captures-go-to.deb7a6: Your captures go to your Photos library and nowhere else.
